reviews.author: Abdul Ashique
reviews.text:
I am writing this to warn others about the lack of technical expertise and professionalism at this garage. My experience here resulted in significant financial loss and further damage to my vehicle.
​The Issues:
​Negligence: I initially visited for routine catalyst and injector cleaning. After the service, the engine began "missing." Upon returning the car for inspection, the garage claimed the engine failed during a test drive due to an oil pump issue and had to be recovered.
​False Promises: Despite claiming they were experienced in repairing similar engines (like the Nissan Patrol), they left my car untouched for 10 days. It was only after I insisted they open the engine that they admitted they could not repair it due to a crack in the engine block.
​Technical Incompetence: I sourced a 2017 replacement engine (an upgrade for my 2014 model). Before delivering it, I explicitly asked if their mechanics could handle the installation/upgrade. They assured me they could, only to backtrack the next day with excuses once the engine arrived.
​Poor Management: Both the staff and the owner were dismissive and unprofessional when confronted with their mistakes.
​Damaged/Missing Parts: After losing trust and moving my car to a different garage, the new mechanics discovered that my AC compressor was broken, the fuel pump socket was snapped, and several parts were missing.
​Verdict:
This garage lacks the basic honesty and technical skill required for automotive repair. They will say "yes" to any job just to take your money, even if they aren't qualified to do the work. Avoid this place at all costs if you value your vehicle.

reviews.author: Syed Kanaan Bari
reviews.text:

The inspection was prompt, the explanation was clear, and the service was carried out efficiently. Since the change, my vehicle has shown significant improvement and the driving experience is now smooth and trouble-free.
I'm happy with the technicians expertise and the professionalism of the management staff. Highly recommend for anyone looking for reliable and honest automotive service in Ajman.

reviews.author: Hafiz Adnan Riaz
reviews.text:
I recently visited Al Bayadh Garage for an engine performance check and ended up getting both an injector cleaning and a catalytic converter cleaning done. The difference in my car's performance is night and day.

Before the service, I was experiencing a sluggish throttle response, minor rough idling, and declining fuel efficiency. The team at Al Bayadh diagnosed the issue quickly and recommended cleaning the fuel injectors and flushing the catalytic system.

The technicians are clearly experienced—they explained the process thoroughly, used professional diagnostic tools, and didn't try to push unnecessary parts or repairs. After the cleaning, the engine runs incredibly smooth, idling is quiet, and the throttle feels crisp and responsive again.

Fair pricing, transparent communication, and efficient turnaround time. If your car is losing power or suffering from poor fuel economy, I highly recommend their specialized cleaning services. Will definitely return for future maintenance
